executive_summary: Maven test compilation failed with 100 errors across 3 test classes. Primary issues: (1) DTO constructors changed from parameterized to no-arg constructors causing instantiation failures, (2) Service method signatures requiring additional userId/username parameters not provided by tests, (3) Type conversions between long/UUID/String types, (4) Missing methods in GlobalExceptionHandler and InMemoryTaskDataStore classes.

errors.message: TaskCreateRequest constructor cannot be applied - requires no arguments but found 5 parameters
errors.root_cause: TaskCreateRequest was refactored to use builder pattern or no-arg constructor with setters, but tests still use parameterized constructor new TaskCreateRequest(title, description, userId, priority, dueDate).
errors.fix_recommendation: Refactor TaskCreateRequest instantiation to use builder pattern: TaskCreateRequest.builder().title(
).description(
).userId(123L).priority(Priority.HIGH).dueDate(LocalDateTime.now()).build() or use no-arg constructor with setters.

errors.root_cause: TaskResponse was refactored to use builder pattern or no-arg constructor, but tests use parameterized constructor.
errors.fix_recommendation: Refactor TaskResponse instantiation to use builder pattern: TaskResponse.builder().id(1L).title(
).description(
).userId(123L).priority(Priority.HIGH).status(TaskStatus.PENDING).createdAt(now).updatedAt(now).completedAt(null).build().

errors.message: createTask method requires userId parameter but test provides only TaskCreateRequest
errors.root_cause: TaskService.createTask signature was changed to require (String userId, TaskCreateRequest request) but tests still call it with only (TaskCreateRequest request).
errors.fix_recommendation: Update all TaskService.createTask() mock calls in tests to include userId as first parameter: when(taskService.createTask(eq(
), any(TaskCreateRequest.class))).

errors.message: TaskResponse constructor with null completedAt cannot be applied
errors.root_cause: TaskResponse constructor expects all 9 parameters but tests pass null for completedAt which causes type inference issues.
errors.fix_recommendation: Use builder pattern for TaskResponse to handle optional fields: TaskResponse.builder().id(1L)...completedAt(null).build() or ensure constructor accepts nullable LocalDateTime.

errors.fix_recommendation: Update all getUserTasks mock calls to: when(taskService.getUserTasks(eq(
))). Change userId from long to String.

errors.root_cause: TaskCountResponse was refactored to use builder pattern or no-arg constructor but tests use parameterized constructor new TaskCountResponse(userId, count).
errors.fix_recommendation: Use builder pattern: TaskCountResponse.builder().userId(123L).count(5).build() or use no-arg constructor with setters.

errors.fix_recommendation: Update all getTaskById calls to: when(taskService.getTaskById(any(UUID.class), eq(

).description(

errors.message: BulkTaskResponse constructor cannot be applied - requires no arguments but found 4 parameters
errors.root_cause: BulkTaskResponse was refactored to use builder pattern or no-arg constructor but tests use parameterized constructor.

errors.message: Method getCode() not found in ErrorResponse
errors.root_cause: ErrorResponse class does not have a getCode() method. Tests expect error code field but it was removed or renamed.
errors.fix_recommendation: Add getCode() method to ErrorResponse class or update tests to use the correct field accessor method (e.g., getErrorCode() or getStatus()).

errors.message: Method handleValidationErrors not found in GlobalExceptionHandler
errors.root_cause: Test expects handleValidationErrors method but GlobalExceptionHandler does not define this method. Either the method was removed or renamed.
errors.fix_recommendation: Add handleValidationErrors method to GlobalExceptionHandler: @ExceptionHandler(MethodArgumentNotValidException.class) public ResponseEntity<ErrorResponse> handleValidationErrors(MethodArgumentNotValidException ex).

errors.message: Type mismatches - userId should be String not long, Priority vs TaskPriority enum
errors.root_cause: InMemoryTaskDataStore expects String userId and TaskPriority enum but tests use long userId and Priority enum.
errors.fix_recommendation: Update InMemoryTaskDataStore to accept String userId instead of long. Align Priority/TaskPriority enum usage across DTOs and domain models.

errors.message: Bad operand types for binary operator '+' - cannot add int to UUID
errors.root_cause: Test attempts to concatenate UUID with integer (taskId + 1) which is not valid. UUID is not a numeric type.
errors.fix_recommendation: Remove arithmetic operations on UUID. Use UUID.randomUUID() to generate new UUIDs or maintain a separate counter for test data generation.
